subject: Post-demo follow-up: Redwood vs hyperscalers — verification tests & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Jane Park <jane.park@stratus.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood vs hyperscalers — initial asks

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier — appreciated how you surfaced the routing and cache ideas. Quick recap from our side and the tests we'd like to run before we kick off a POC: 

Key concerns we raised on the call
- Hallucination frequency on multi-turn summarization for our internal docs (sensitive content)
- Latency p95 under 300ms for 512-token responses when under 80% load
- Determinism/regression on long-context QA (8k tokens) vs what we currently run on GiantCloud endpoints

Immediate next tests we want from Redwood (high-level)
1) Run the "hallucination-probe" prompt set against the candidate model and against GiantCloud baseline — return hallucination rate, examples, and conf intervals (CSV).
2) Long-context regression: take our 2k+ token docs and run extractive QA, compare F1/EM and error types.
3) Throughput run: 1k concurrent tiny requests (128 tokens) and a 100-concurrent 512-token stream to measure p50/p95/p99 and cost per token.

Attachments: call-recording-20270612.mp3 (recording), sample-docs.zip (we'll upload full corpus if you want)

Timing: we'd like initial results within one week (by 2027-06-19) so procurement can scope Dedicated capacity. 

Can you confirm owners & a proposed test plan? Also need a template for the benchmarking harness (script + metrics).

Thanks — Jane
Jane Park
Head of ML Engineering, Stratus AI
---
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@stratus.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood vs hyperscalers — initial asks

Jane — great to connect. Short answers and a concrete plan below. Thanks for the clear ask list.

Owners & rough schedule
- Hallucination probe: rishi_malhotra (lead) — will run our probe suite + GiantCloud baseline (deliverable: hallucination_report.csv) — DUE 2027-06-18
- Long-context regression: monica_patel (lead) — will run extractive QA on your 2k+ docs and produce F1/EM and error taxonomy — DUE 2027-06-18
- Throughput/latency: ben_carter (lead) — 2 modes: 1) small request burst 2) streaming 512 tokens — include p50/p95/p99 and cost model — DUE 2027-06-19

What we'll deliver
- A single ZIP with CSVs and sample outputs (scored and raw)
- A short playbook describing Redwood's differentiators for production inference:
  * Smart routing (latency-first vs cost-first policies)
  * Prefix / KV caching to reduce token cost on multi-turn stateful flows
  * Quantization profiles we can recommend per workload to keep quality within your acceptance band
  * Canary rollout with automatic fallback to compatible variants to avoid regressions in steady traffic

Immediate asks from your side
- Share sample docs (S3 or Drive link) and a HubSpot deal record if available (we'll attach test mappings to that deal).
- Grant a short-lived API key for a dedicated test project OR let us spin a Dedicated trial node for a 2-day benchmark (we can do both).

Attachments: redwood-test-prompts.csv (our starting prompt set), mutual-action-plan.docx (M.A.P draft)
Related links: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4821

If that schedule works I'll kick off tasks and invite folks to a brief sync on Monday to align test harness details.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>

Cc: Jane Park <jane.park@stratus.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood vs hyperscalers — initial asks

Looping internal owners so responsibilities are explicit. Quick operational notes: 

Action items (internal)
- rishi_malhotra: please run hallucination-probe suite against the candidate open-model we recommended + GiantCloud baseline. Record exact prompt variants and temperature seeds. Use the provided redwood-test-prompts.csv as the base. (ETA 2027-06-18)
- ben_carter: coordinate with procurement@stratus.ai for Dedicated trial access & provide the Dedicated trial checklist (security & IP requirements). (ETA 2027-06-16)
- markus_klein: schedule 30m sync with Stratus engineering Monday 2027-06-15 10:00 ET to finalize keys and S3 access.

Acceptance criteria per test (tentative)
- Hallucination: false-positive hallucination rate < 6% on the probe set OR examples where Redwood returns higher-confidence correct answers than GiantCloud.
- Long-context: F1 delta <= 3 pts vs GiantCloud OR documented error modes where Redwood outperforms on co-reference chains.
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms for 512-token responses under the defined concurrent workload; cost per 1M tokens measured and included in report.

I'll start a shared folder and drop the harness template and a CI script for running the runs. Will attach provisioning checklist.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
